label: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC
why: Pre-registered aligned = sign(ret_0)*flow_imbalance scores down-agree hours as HIGH (long). That is the wrong stand-in for continuation-in-the-price-direction. This file uses frozen F03 thresholds and only splits agree vs disagree.
interpretation: Inside F03 tails, hours where flow sign matches price sign separate 4h tick returns more than disagreement hours. This does not authorize a new strategy. It only says the abs() formula keeps dead-weight HIGH disagreement hours (mean ~0 bps).
